LESSON: DESCANT RECORDER

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.6: Descant Recorder

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Descant Recorder. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is the value of sight reading music?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions
2. appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: DESCANT RECORDER
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Descant Recorder helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: DESCANT RECORDER
Study Descant Recorder like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions

What this means
In this part you learn to perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Descant Recorder” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Descant Recorder in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Descant Recorder is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Descant Recorder” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Descant Recorder in your own words. (skill: appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Descant Recorder to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Descant Recorder from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Descant Recorder: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Descant Recorder?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the value of sight reading music?
2. Why are performance directions important in music?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Descant Recorder means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions.
5. Be able to: appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
